scope: Deterministic representation repair only; no title interpretation and no substantive code invention.

dependency_repairs: Visible actor position plus omission realization uses an explicit actor realization selected from the already-coded position.
Visible event plus not_visible target position uses object_omitted target realization.
Out-of-schema privacy realization fields are removed while raw output remains sealed.
A visible person with an empty gender-position array inherits already-coded substantive positions, or gender_unspecified if none exists.
additional_rules.evidence_policy: Evidence-row validity and selected-code coverage are recorded as derived QA flags; incomplete evidence does not invalidate semantic labels.

prohibitions: No change between substantive semantic codes.
No inference from title text inside the normalizer.
No overwrite of raw provider output.
